*   `?g B2`: Main Concept is a Character/Fictional/Imaginary.
    *   `+ D2`: Sub-concept (group g) - Masculine/Male.
    *   `+ A6`: Sub-concept (group g) - Cinema/Movie.
    *   `!r D4`: Sub-concept (group r) - Attack/Conflict/Combat/Weapon.
    *   `+ Black`: Sub-concept (group r) - Black color.
    *   `!y E11`: Sub-concept (group y) - Zero/None/Absence.
    *   `+ E11`: Sub-concept (group y) - Zero/None/Absence (redundant/emphasis).
    *   `!b C14`: Sub-concept (group b) - Eye/Sight.
    *   `+ Clear`: Sub-concept (group b) - Transparent/Invisible/Glass.
